hook.firstLine: You think splitting one fortune makes everyone rich?

lines.gist: Questions if distributing a billionaire's wealth actually makes everyone rich.
Sets up scenario of a two hundred billion dollar billionaire fortune.
Explains dividing this wealth equally across the entire world population.
Reveals each person would only receive twenty five dollars or one meal.
Compares the same fortune relative to a single worker's perspective.
Calculates that earning that amount at standard salary takes millions of years.
Contrasts both perspectives and asks if audience still supports wealth redistribution.

ending.lastFrame: Split comparison with host asking STILL SPLIT IT? directly leading back to opening action

whyItWorks: Uses clear visual metaphors like slicing a money stack to instantly communicate abstract economics.
Contrasts a micro perspective ($25 dinner) with a macro perspective (4 million years of labor).
Maintains strong viewer engagement with bold, color-coded text cards for key figures.
Concludes with an open question that seamlessly loops back to the video hook.
